inventoryFields.images[].attachment: Unique flat PDF attachment key, never SOP Instance UID
inventoryFields.images[].sourcePath: Original relative input path used for recovery
inventoryFields.images[].sha256: SHA-256 over complete unchanged original file bytes
inventoryFields.images[].supplied: True for every inventoried regular input file
inventoryFields.images[].embedded: True only when original is embedded; verifier checks actual presence
inventoryFields.images[].displayRejected: True when source is preserved but rejected for preview rendering
inventoryFields.images[].referencePage: One-based preview or diagnostic PDF page
inventoryFields.images[].sourceFrame: One-based source frame1 for PDF baseline; viewer may inspect additional frames without changing the baseline
inventoryFields.images[].status: rendered or unrendered; an unrendered file remains embedded
inventoryFields.images[].reason: Rendering rejection reason; null for a rendered preview
inventoryFields.references[]: Explicit Referenced SOP Instance UID occurrences found recursively in readable sequence items; targets resolved against all supplied instance IDs. Statuses include resolved, missing, ambiguous, invalid-frame and class-mismatch. A diagnostic unassessed row at /REFERENCE_SCAN_INCOMPLETE (null UID, no frames or targets) records an incomplete scan after readable metadata; it does not invent a DICOM reference. Unreadable originals are reported separately. No clinical study completeness is inferred.
inventoryFields.duplicateInstanceUIDs: Instance UIDs present in multiple supplied files; no overwriting or arbitrary choice
inventoryFields.images[].previewSha256: SHA-256 over generated reference raster RGB8 bytes, row-major top-to-bottom, left-to-right, channel order R,G,B; null for rejected displays
inventoryFields.artifactSha256: SHA-256 map for package resources/inventory/viewer; manifest.json is separately hashed by manifest.sha256 to avoid self-reference

displayAdjustments.windowCenter: Effective numeric center used to generate preview; source window value0 or explicit auto minimum/maximum result; float input recorded exactly as supplied to dcm4che
displayAdjustments.windowWidth: Effective numeric width used to generate preview; >=1; float input recorded exactly as supplied to dcm4che
displayAdjustments.rescaleSlope: Effective dcm4che float from source RescaleSlope (0028,1053), default 1 only for display if absent; exact source text remains in fields
displayAdjustments.rescaleIntercept: Effective dcm4che float from source RescaleIntercept (0028,1052), default 0 only for display if absent; exact source text remains in fields
displayAdjustments.invert: True for MONOCHROME1; false for MONOCHROME2
displayAdjustments.voiLUTFunction: LINEAR; other functions and LUT sequences rejected
displayAdjustments.overlayPolicy: disabled; embedded overlays are not drawn on preview
displayAdjustments.pixelAspectRatio: 1:1 unitless display; no calibrated measurement assertion
displayAdjustments.color: True for a color/palette reference, false for grayscale
displayAdjustments.sourceFrame: One-based frame used for the PDF reference
displayAdjustments.rescaleSource: Source location/default used for effective rescale, including enhanced functional groups
displayAdjustments.windowSource: Source location/default used for effective VOI window

normalization: Missing source fields remain absent. Display defaults are recorded separately and are never written into the original DICOM or passed off as source metadata.
